overview:
**Master in Electrical Engineering in Switzerland** is an opportunity to acquire advanced technical knowledge and to explore research opportunities within the discipline of modern electrical and electronic engineering. A **Master’s in Electrical Engineering in Switzerland for Indian Students** offers exposure to advanced technical education and international research environments. Students who want to **Study Master’s in Electrical Engineering in Switzerland** can explore specialized programs at leading Swiss institutions.

Advanced study paths in electrical engineering are available at universities such as ETH Zurich and EPFL . Names of the programs, structure of courses, admission requirements and languages of instruction differ. Indian applicants should check the exact details of the program before applying.

Currency note: Estimates in INR are based on an approximate planning rate of CHF 1 \= INR 110\. Exchange rates fluctuate and we recommend that you confirm all fees with the university before applying.
